paite: Huan akha sawm-le-nih, Adar kha, huai mah ani sawm-le-thum ni, kumpipa thupiak leh athubawl tangtunna ding ahong nai lai in, Judate melmate'n atung ua vaihawmna neih akilamet ni uh; hinapi a, ahilou lam a hong kilehbut a, Judate'n amau mudahte tung a vaihawmna ahon neih lai un;
heading: Judate'n Amelmate Uh Ahihsia Uh

paite: Kumpipa Ahasueras bial tengteng akhopite uah Judate, amau siatna zongte tung a khut kha ding in, akikhawmkhawm ua: kuamah in lah amaute anangzou kei uhi; mite tengteng tung ah lah amaute launa ahong omta hi.
Huchi in bialte a vaihawmte leh gamuk mite leh ukpipate leh kumpipa nasemte'n, Judate apanpih ua; Mordekai launa lah atung uah ahong om ngal a.
Kumpipa' inn ah Mordekai athupi a, bial tengteng ah amin athangkheta hi: hiai mipa Mordekai lah ahong thupi semsem hi.
Huchi in namsau a sat in Judate'n amelmate tengteng athat ua, thahna leh hihsiatna in, amaute mudahte tung ah ahih ding uh ahihta uhi.
Susa Inpi ah Judate'n mi zanga athat ua ahihgawp uhi.
Parsandatha, Dalphon, Aspatha,
Poratha, Adalia, Aridatha,
Parmashta, Arisai, Aridai, Vajezathate,
Judate melmapa Hammedatha tapa Haman tapate, athat ua; himahleh gallak ah akhut uh anga kei uhi.
Huai ni in Susa Inpi a thah a om zah kumpipa ma ah ahon tawi uhi.

Huan kumpipa'n kumpinu Esther kiang ah, "Judate'n Susa Inpi sung ah mi zanga athat ua ahihsia uh, Haman tapa sawmte toh; kumpipa bial dangte ah bang achi bawlta phet ding uam ah: Khai le, bang ahia na nget? Na kiang ah phal ahi ding; ahihkeileh bang ngetbeh na nei lai a? Suk pichin ahi ding," achi hi.
Esther in, "Kumpipa' lungkimna ahihleh, zingchiang a tuni a thupiak bangbang a gamtang ding in Susa a om Judate phal inla, Haman tapa sawmte khailupna khuam ah kikhai le uh," achi hi.
Huchi in huchibang a hih ahi ding chi in kumpipa'n thu apia hi: Susa ah thubawl akipekhia a: huchi in Haman tapa sawmte akhaita uhi.
Adar kha mah ani sawm-le-li ni in Susa a om Judate akikhawmkhawm ua, Susa ah mi zathum athat uh; himahleh gallak tung ah akhut uh anga kei uhi.

Huchi in kumpipa bialte a om Juda dangte akikhawmkhawm ua, ahinna uh ahum ua, amelmate ua kipan khawlna anei ua, amau mudahte lak ah mi singsagih-le-sangnga athat ua; himahleh gallak tung ah akhut uh anga kei uh.
Adar kha ani sawm-le-thum ni in hiai tuh hih ahi; huai mah ani sawm-le-li ni in akhawl ua, ankuanglui ni leh kipahna ni in azang uhi.
Himahleh Susa a om Judate akikhawm ua, ani sawm-le-thum ni in leh ani sawm-le-li ni in; huai mah ani sawm-le-nga ni in akhawlta ua, ankuanglui ni leh kipahna ni in azang uhi.
Huaiziak in khoneute a Judate, kho kulhbaang nei lou a tengte'n, Adar kha ani sawm-le-li ni kipahna ni leh ankuanglui ni in, ni hoih, khat-le-khat tantuan kikhaktuahna ni in azang uhi.
Huan Mordekai in hiai thilte agelh a, kumpipa Ahasueras bial tengteng a om Judate, gamla leh nai a omte kiang ah akhak hi.
heading: Purim Kut Kipatna

paite: Kum teng a, Adar kha ani sawm-le-li leh ani sawm- le-nga ni, kum teng a tan ding ahilhna ding in,

Judate amelmate ua kipan akhawl ni uh, amau a dia lungkhamna kipahna ahong hihna kha, misi suunna ni hoih ahong hihna kha bang in: huai nite ankuangluina leh kipahna ni a a-om ua, tantuante khat-le-khat akikhaktuah uhi; gentheite kiang a thilpiakte piakna aneihtheihna ding un.
Huchi in Judate'n apatkhitsa bang un leh Mordekai in amaute kiang a agelh khitsa bang in hih ding in atheisiam uhi.

Agag mi Hammedatha tapa Haman, Juda tengteng melmapa'n Juda tengteng siatna ding amau hihse ding, angaihtuah a, amaute hihgawp ding leh amaute hihse ding a, Pur, (huai tuh aisan ahi) ana paih ziak in.

Himahleh athu kumpipa ma ahong tun in, angaihtuah gilou, Judate siatna ding a angaihtuah, ama lutung mahmah a kibung ding in laikhakte in thu apeta a; huchi a amah leh atapate khailupna khuam a khai a a-omna ding un.
Huchibang ahih ziak in hiai nite Pur min zui in Purim asa uhi. Huaiziak in hiai laikhak thute tengteng ziak leh hiai thu tungtang thu amuhsa uh, atung ua ahong tun ziak in.

Judate'n ahihkip ua, amau tung leh asuante uh tung leh amaute huchibang akizomkhawm bangte tengteng tung ah akisuanta uhi, huchi a pel lou a, huai a laigelh dungzui leh huai a hun sehsa dungzui a, kum chiteng a hiai ni nihte atantheihna ding un.

Huchi a hiai nite akhang-akhang a, a-inkuankuan a, bial chiteng leh khopi chiteng atheihgigeleh tan a a-omtheihna ding in; huchi a hiai Purim nite Judate lak a kipan a azuau louh a, huaite theihgigena leng asuante uh a kipan amanlouhna ding in.
Huchi in kumpinu Esther, Abihail tanu leh Juda mi Mordekai in, hiai Purim laikhak nihna sukkipna ding in thuneihna tengteng in agelhta uhi.
Judate tengteng kiang ah, Ahasueras gam a bial zakhat sawmnih-le-sagihte kiang ah, lungmuanna leh thutak thute, laikhakte akhakta hi.

Hiai Purim nite a hun asehsa uh, Juda mi Mordekai leh kumpinu Esther in huaite pha asak uh dungzui leh amau a ding leh asuante uh a dia, an ngawlna leh akahna thu ua ana hihkip bang ua hihkip ding in.
Esther thupiak in hiai Purim thute ahihkip a; laibu ah kigelh ahita hi.
